title: Dzvin.co | Product Strategy & Investment Dossier
lead: Product strategy, QDIP / Decision Intelligence research, engineering maturity and the programme leading to controlled launch.

articles.title: Executive Investment Overview
articles.summary: Problem, DI × mental-health thesis, existing assets, execution milestones and funding purpose

sections.title: The investment thesis
paragraphs: Dzvin.co is a people-first digital mental-wellbeing project with personal, prospective enterprise, and research experiences. Its proposed scientific differentiator is applying Decision Intelligence and QDIP research principles to explainable, uncertainty-aware, human-controlled action selection rather than risk scores alone.
Existing engineering work provides the foundation for the next stage: integration qualification, security, research validation and controlled product deployment.

sections.title: What the investment stage will deliver
paragraphs: The programme consists of WP1 — integration and data protection; WP2 — Decision Intelligence research methods and comparative evaluation; WP3 — user feasibility; and WP4 — independent assessment and launch readiness.
Funding is tied to verifiable outputs from each work package, from product qualification to independent evaluation and launch preparation.

sections.title: What is verifiable now
paragraphs: Public material includes web-interface code, B2C/B2B/R&D feature modules, source-of-truth roadmap and launch gates, and QDIP's public research narrative.
The evidence register distinguishes implemented software from integrated release qualification and future empirical results.

sections.title: The falsifiable hypothesis
paragraphs: Can a transparent policy that incorporates temporal risk signals, uncertainty and the ability to abstain improve a preregistered decision-level metric over static advice or prediction alone?
The research design includes baseline comparisons, prespecified indicators, model calibration, safety analysis and human oversight of suggested actions.

sections.title: Why now
paragraphs: Existing technical groundwork makes controlled experiments and release qualification possible without starting from a blank project, while integration and scientific risks remain material.
The investment stage advances the product from software foundations to a qualified system with reproducible technical and scientific evidence.

sections.title: Next meeting
paragraphs: Investor engagement covers technology diligence, stage milestones and partnership terms. Research funding covers methodology, deliverables, potential impact and governance.
A binding application additionally requires verified team, legal applicant, staffing, detailed budget, schedule, IP/FTO and eligible funding instrument.

articles.title: Strategic Investment Rationale
articles.summary: The opportunity, project hypothesis and what the next tranche should achieve

sections.title: The project
paragraphs: Dzvin.co combines three related experiences: a private personal wellbeing journey, permissioned team analytics, and a controlled research workspace.
Our research opportunity is applying Decision Intelligence to transform observations and risk signals into explainable, human-supervised next actions with stated uncertainty and feedback.

sections.title: Why the problem matters
paragraphs: Standalone check-ins and one-off surveys can fragment observations, context and follow-up. A prediction alone does not tell a user or decision maker which safe action is appropriate.
Mental-health AI needs explicit attention to uncertain and incomplete data, human agency, privacy, bias and the actual outcome of decisions.

sections.title: Who it may serve
paragraphs: Individuals who want to observe their personal trajectory; HR and managers who need authorized aggregate context rather than employee surveillance; researchers studying repeated measures and intervention processes.
Research applications support cohort-based studies, longitudinal observations and controlled evaluation. The application segments have distinct validation criteria.

sections.title: Existing development evidence
paragraphs: The software repositories contain user-facing interfaces, backend risk/decision-support modules, research-workspace components, tests and methodological specifications.
The codebase forms the starting point for system qualification; external pilot and research outcomes belong to the next programme stage.

sections.title: The next value-creation milestone
paragraphs: Complete release/security integration, turn research hypotheses into reproducible protocols, enable responsibly recruited pilots, study usefulness and uncertainty, and prepare a controlled product launch.
Stage financing can be linked to the acceptance of individual work packages and documented progression criteria.

sections.title: Potential sustainability
paragraphs: Hypotheses include future B2B service contracts, funded research partnerships and a separately sustainable personal experience.
Business-model parameters will be refined through demand analysis, pricing research, implementation costs and scalability assessment.

articles.title: Scientific Programme: Decision Intelligence in Mental Wellbeing
articles.summary: QDIP as a research-enabling decision framework, scientific hypotheses and validation criteria

sections.title: From prediction to a decision
paragraphs: A risk model estimates an outcome. Decision Intelligence asks what action could be appropriate, given evidence, alternatives, constraints, uncertainty and human choice.
Human oversight and intended-use boundaries remain central to the research design, particularly when information is incomplete or uncertain.

sections.title: Role of QDIP
paragraphs: QDIP is a distinct Decision Intelligence technology track exploring hybrid rule/model signals, policy governance, explanation, audit and monitoring.
Dzvin.co provides the application context for investigating QDIP principles. Integrated system qualification and comparative scientific evaluation remain planned research activities.

sections.title: Hypothesis 1: temporal change
paragraphs: Personal trajectories and changing baselines may provide richer signals than a one-off score when data are intermittent.
Evaluation: simple baseline comparison, false alarms, detection delay, missing-data robustness.

sections.title: Hypothesis 2: uncertainty and abstention
paragraphs: When observations are sparse or noisy, the system should express uncertainty and be able to withhold a risky recommendation.
Evaluation: calibration, selective risk, abstention frequency and robustness on incomplete time series.

sections.title: Hypothesis 3: explainable action selection
paragraphs: Explore a transparent path from observations to alternative actions, constraints, an explanation, user choice and feedback.
Evaluation: rule-only versus ML-only versus hybrid baselines, audit completeness, explanation comprehension and user override.

sections.title: Hypothesis 4: actionable benefit
paragraphs: Test whether decision-aware, user-controlled support improves an agreed proximal outcome relative to fixed suggestions.
Start with feasibility work. Randomized or micro-randomized evaluation requires adequate protocol, ethics and participant protections. No study outcome is claimed.

sections.title: What is genuinely novel?
paragraphs: Adaptive interventions, Bayesian approaches and micro-randomized trials have established scientific foundations. The proposed contribution lies in their domain-specific integration with policy governance, transparency and human control.

Potential contribution lies in the domain-specific, testable combination of policies, uncertainty, explanations, feedback and human control. Novelty remains subject to prior-art assessment and experimental evidence.

articles.title: Development Status and Engineering Readiness
articles.summary: Real engineering artifacts versus open release and validation gates

sections.title: Current stage — October 25, 2026
paragraphs: As of 25 October 2026, Dzvin.co is a software prototype with components supporting personal, organizational and research experiences. Production integration and field evaluation form part of the next programme stage.
Readiness is assessed through integrated workflows, authorization, security controls and operational reliability.

sections.title: Personal product
paragraphs: The web code includes check-ins, journal, exercises, personal progress, goals and questionnaires. The product roadmap calls for a connected check-in → user-chosen support → feedback → history journey.
Production readiness still requires fully verified auth, privacy, real API and browser end-to-end flows.

sections.title: Organizations
paragraphs: Company administration, groups, permissions, analytics and manager decision support have frontend implementations.
Multi-tenant authorization, backend migrations, privileged access checks and real operator E2E are launch gates, not completed customer deployments.

sections.title: Research workspace
paragraphs: There are project, membership, cohort, inspection, dataset, export-request and audit UI/API artifacts.
External study partners, ethics processes, real datasets and qualified research workflows remain pending.

sections.title: Decision Intelligence integration
paragraphs: Research documentation covers adaptive risk, explanation, policy control and scientific evaluation plans. Backend decision-support components exist.
Scientific advantage and integrated clinical/operational effectiveness have not been established in real settings.

sections.title: What qualifies as complete
paragraphs: A feature must pass the relevant authorization, privacy, end-to-end, operational and auditability checks in the target environment.
Completion is recorded against defined acceptance criteria, target environments and reproducible test evidence.

articles.title: Technology Assets and Evidence Register
articles.summary: Separate software evidence from unverified use cases, research claims and launch gates

sections.title: How to interpret readiness
paragraphs: The register distinguishes design documentation, implemented source code, component tests, integrated release checks and empirical evaluation.
The matrix below references public engineering and methodological sources. It does not certify all features as safely activated for every account.

sections.title: B2C personal
paragraphs: The web repository contains personal check-in, history, exercise and self-support components and related roadmap tasks.
Status: code artifacts available; a full live identity/backend/browser E2E is not independently certified by this dossier.

sections.title: B2B organizations
paragraphs: There are company routes, roles, team analytics and manager decision-support code, but secure multi-tenant access and data migration remain launch gates.
Status: partially implemented, guarded activation, no verified enterprise customers or field impact.

sections.title: R&D research
paragraphs: Research Workspace covers projects, cohorts, inspection, datasets, export requests and audit; formal methodology work is documented.
Status: software/research baseline, not external validation or completed ethics-reviewed trial.

sections.title: QDIP / Decision Intelligence
paragraphs: The public QDIP research narrative describes hybrid rules/models, policy governance, explanations, risk signals and evaluation.
Status: conceptual and engineering foundations; a statistically demonstrated advantage within Dzvin is pending.

sections.title: How evidence will change
paragraphs: An upgrade to 'validated' requires date, artifact/commit, environment, explicit test or study protocol, and accountable sign-off.
Evidence status advances following verification of the relevant environment and acceptance criteria.

articles.title: Dzvin.co Development Roadmap
articles.summary: Milestones, acceptance gates and observable deliverables

sections.title: Phase 1 — secure integration
paragraphs: Qualify frontend, NestJS, QDIP boundaries, identity, tenant isolation and rollback.
Exit: reproducible builds, authorized real API flows, security negatives and QA integration evidence.

sections.title: Phase 2 — research design
paragraphs: Define hypotheses, prediction baselines, abstention criteria, harm safeguards, metrics, consent and data protocol.
Exit: registered evaluation protocol, reproducible synthetic baseline comparisons, risk and ethical review.

sections.title: Phase 3 — human feasibility
paragraphs: Recruit appropriately consented participants/partners and evaluate usability, acceptability and data quality in a bounded study.
Exit: feasible workflow and transparent findings; any required ethics approval obtained before real participant research.

sections.title: Phase 4 — DI evaluation
paragraphs: Compare policy approaches using suitable data and preregistered metrics for calibration, harms, explanation and decision usefulness.
Exit: auditable report including confidence intervals, limitations and negative findings.

sections.title: Phase 5 — controlled launch
paragraphs: Prepare production monitoring, support, data policy, deployment gates and a sustainable operating model.
Exit: go/no-go review, production E2E and credible operating plan. Dates depend on budget and partnership commitments.

sections.title: How to interpret this roadmap
paragraphs: The roadmap defines ordered, dependent milestones. Timelines, team capacity and resource requirements are determined in the approved delivery plan.
Only mark a phase done when its explicit acceptance evidence is available.

articles.title: Implementation Programme WP1–WP4
articles.summary: A verifiable execution plan connected to risks, deliverables and actual resource budgeting

sections.title: WP1 — secure integrated product
paragraphs: Complete Web ↔ NestJS ↔ QDIP contracts, identity, company isolation, permissions, real end-to-end tests and rollback.
Exit: repeatable CI and QA E2E, negative security cases, approved go/no-go and a controlled deployment record.

sections.title: WP2 — Decision Intelligence methods
paragraphs: Formalize decision policies and baselines, calibration and abstention, missingness tests, rule/model/hybrid comparisons and the statistical plan.
Exit: preregistered research protocol, reproducible synthetic benchmarks and an uncertainty/bias report, including failed hypotheses.

sections.title: WP3 — human feasibility and ethics
paragraphs: Define consent, minimization, study population, user experience protocol and appropriately controlled real-world feasibility. No recruitment partner is represented as already signed.
Exit: approved ethics/legal framework, responsibly gathered data, qualitative UX findings and non-inflated outcome reporting.

sections.title: WP4 — evidence and controlled launch
paragraphs: If suitable data are available, evaluate decision usefulness and human control; prepare independent review, monitoring, support and the sustainability model.
Exit: auditable results, documented go/no-go, operational checklist, refreshed risk and financial register.

sections.title: Dependencies
paragraphs: WP1 is a release prerequisite; WP2 can run in parallel using synthetic data. WP3 cannot collect real data before required safety/ethics conditions; WP4 requires appropriate evidence quality.
Unmet gates trigger a scope/financing review, not a success claim.

sections.title: Resources and governance
paragraphs: Budget buckets: engineering, Decision Science/ML, privacy/security/ethics, UX and participants, infrastructure and operations.
The work-package financial plan will map duration, staffing, direct costs, accountable owners and acceptance deliverables. Investment terms are defined in a separate proposal.

articles.title: Technology and Scientific Validation Programme
articles.summary: Technical qualification, user feasibility and decision-level evaluation

sections.title: Engineering evidence
paragraphs: Verify authentication, tenant boundaries, real interfaces, resilience and operational rollback.
Artifacts: reproducible CI, runtime E2E, negative security cases and traceable logs.

sections.title: Ethics and data
paragraphs: Begin with synthetic scenarios. For real data, establish consent, minimization, access boundaries and appropriate research approval.
Evaluate reidentification risk, bias and harmful overconfidence; aggregation alone is not anonymity.

sections.title: Scientific baselines
paragraphs: Compare simple or static rule-based approaches with hybrid policies and explicit uncertainty.
Predefine calibration, Brier score, missing-data stability, selective risk, alerts, detection delay and decision utility where applicable.

sections.title: Human usefulness
paragraphs: Study completion of the daily journey, comprehension of explanations, user autonomy and acceptability.
Product studies will establish the evidence required to assess user value, workflow reliability and further development options.

sections.title: Research quality
paragraphs: Maintain protocols, reproducibility, model configurations, negative results and independent review.
Use established guidance such as TRIPOD+AI where prediction reporting applies; reporting guidelines do not substitute for clinical/ethics approval.

sections.title: Go/no-go
paragraphs: Progress when engineering safety, data quality and pre-agreed decision value criteria are met. Stop or revise when access control fails, uncertainty is unsafe or no useful evidence emerges.
Results outside agreed thresholds trigger a documented review of the underlying hypothesis, model or programme scope.

articles.title: Dzvin.co Investment Opportunity
articles.summary: From an existing software prototype to a launch-qualified product: technology, milestone outcomes and growth options

sections.title: A technology platform with an applied research opportunity
paragraphs: Dzvin.co brings together personal wellbeing support, planned organization-level insights and a research workspace. The QDIP / Decision Intelligence direction explores explainable next-action selection with context, explicit uncertainty and human control.
The opportunity builds on existing engineering assets and their potential to become a validated product across distinct use cases. Technical and scientific advantages remain to be tested.

sections.title: The investment thesis
paragraphs: The next development stage is designed to create an asset with auditable engineering readiness, explicit risk management and evidence of product feasibility. Funding supports technology development and market discovery rather than scaling unverified sales.
Possible future avenues include organizational subscriptions, a personal wellbeing product and research collaborations. Their commercial viability will be evaluated, not assumed.

sections.title: Milestone outcomes
paragraphs: A qualified integrated product with verified roles, tenant boundaries, real end-to-end flows and operational safeguards; formal Decision Intelligence research protocols; controlled assessment of user workflows.
The intended outputs are software artifacts, reproducible tests, security findings, scientific reports and a documented launch-readiness decision—not preclaimed clinical or financial outcomes.

sections.title: Execution and checkpoints
paragraphs: WP1: product integration and security. WP2: QDIP / DI research baselines, comparative protocols and metrics. WP3: human-centered usability and feasibility research under appropriate ethics controls. WP4: independent analysis and controlled launch preparation.
Each work package has acceptance criteria and go/no-go gates. Dependencies and evidence are documented in the execution plan and evidence register.

sections.title: Potential sustainability
paragraphs: Following product and market validation, options to evaluate include enterprise licensing, funded research collaborations and further development of the personal experience.
Commercial planning will rely on evidence from future studies, willingness-to-pay research, operating costs, product quality and long-term support requirements.

sections.title: Investment and research partnerships
paragraphs: For private investors: discuss funding the next technology milestone with measurable deliverables, risk governance and reporting. For foundations: defined research work packages, evaluation methods and prospective impact.

Capital amount, detailed budget, timetable and contractual terms are developed in a tailored investment or grant proposal. Investor and grant presentations, the roadmap and the evidence register are available for review.

articles.title: Dzvin.co Product Concept
articles.summary: How Dzvin.co connects team-level patterns with a managed response

sections.title: Product strategy
paragraphs: Dzvin.co is being developed as a platform connecting wellbeing observations with context and follow-up processes across personal, organizational and research workstreams.
The common principle is to move from an isolated signal to an explainable, human-controlled option and its subsequent evaluation.

sections.title: Organizational application
paragraphs: The target design provides authorized group-level trends and a structured process for responsible staff to review signals.
Permissions, privacy safeguards, enterprise readiness and operational value remain subject to dedicated validation.

sections.title: Research connection
paragraphs: The research programme examines how policy rules, model signals, uncertainty and explanations can improve informed action selection.
QDIP is considered a technology direction for evaluating this hypothesis within mental wellbeing.

articles.title: Target Segments and Applications
articles.summary: Organizations first, with separate personal and research use cases

sections.title: Personal segment
paragraphs: The personal workstream combines repeated self-reports, longitudinal history, goals and optional practices.
Its intended purpose is structured reflection and self-directed action, not automated clinical assessment.

sections.title: Organizational segment
paragraphs: The target experience includes organizational roles, group indicators and a controlled team-support process.
Development priorities cover permissions, data quality, user feasibility and prospective commercial requirements.

sections.title: Research segment
paragraphs: Research Workspace is designed around projects, participants, cohorts, repeated measurements, controlled data access and audit.
The potential value is a reproducible environment for comparing decision policies and analytical models.

articles.title: Product Capability Architecture
articles.summary: Personal, organizational and research capabilities without inflated claims

sections.title: Personal capabilities
paragraphs: Software components cover check-ins, notes, questionnaires, practices, goals and history.
Connected end-to-end journeys and integration stability remain part of release qualification.

sections.title: Organizational capabilities
paragraphs: The prototype contains routes and components for companies, groups, permissions, trends and event review.
Verified authorization, tenant isolation and operational safeguards are required before organizational deployment.

sections.title: Research capabilities

Research use requires approved protocols, data-quality governance and applicable ethical review.

articles.title: Core User Journeys
articles.summary: Three product journeys to verify during a demonstration

sections.title: Personal user journey
paragraphs: Target sequence: check-in → history → optional practice → subsequent observation.
Qualification examines consistent data flow, permissions and user interaction across the full journey.

sections.title: Organizational journey
paragraphs: Target sequence: authorized group → time-series trend → event review → documented follow-up action.
Validation covers role boundaries, organization isolation, data availability and traceable actions.

sections.title: Research journey
paragraphs: Target sequence: research project → cohort → data history → inspection → controlled export → audit.
Technical demonstrations use test data; participant research requires separate protocols and approvals.

articles.title: Commercialization and Economic Model
articles.summary: A transparent pilot scenario calculator, not a fabricated ROI estimate

sections.title: Commercialization avenues
paragraphs: The future model may include contracted enterprise services, a personal experience and research partnerships.
Next-stage priorities are segment-value discovery and the economics of operating the product, rather than unsupported revenue forecasts.

sections.title: Economic evaluation framework
paragraphs: Enterprise research will examine implementation effort, usage, event-handling processes and operational cost drivers.
Personal and research segments require separate assessments of feasibility, engagement, servicing cost and data governance.

sections.title: Financial-model development
paragraphs: Commercial assumptions will be refined through stakeholder interviews, integration studies and appropriately structured pilots.
The model will account for acquisition, support and infrastructure costs, possible pricing options and deployment scenarios.

articles.title: Market Positioning
articles.summary: Dzvin.co alongside one-off surveys and standalone dashboards

sections.title: Solution categories
paragraphs: Standalone surveys collect periodic feedback; dashboards summarize data; decision-support tools add structured evaluation and follow-up actions.
Dzvin.co explores integrating these layers with personal journeys and research infrastructure.

sections.title: Differentiation hypothesis
paragraphs: The research programme combines longitudinal signals, policy constraints, model uncertainty, explanations and human oversight.
Any advantage over alternative approaches requires comparable evaluation and independent evidence.

sections.title: Market assessment framework
paragraphs: The analysis will cover functional scope, privacy, integration effort, user feasibility and decision auditability.
Comparisons will use consistent criteria, traceable sources and dated assessments.

articles.title: Pilot Validation Strategy
articles.summary: Define the evaluation design and success criteria

sections.title: Pilot programme objectives
paragraphs: The pilot programme is designed to evaluate key journeys, data quality, operational security and initial usefulness hypotheses.
Participant selection, permissions, inclusion criteria and methods are defined before real-data collection.

sections.title: Evaluation methodology
paragraphs: Candidate metrics cover journey completion, repeat use, data quality, permitted-signal review time and explanation comprehension.
The QDIP research stream uses separate protocols for calibration, false alerts and decision-level utility.

sections.title: Progression decision
paragraphs: Observed results are evaluated against preregistered acceptance criteria, risk thresholds and implementation costs.
The programme decision may support expansion, targeted remediation or revision of the associated hypothesis.

articles.title: Personal Product Overview
articles.summary: What the service does and how to begin

sections.title: Purpose
paragraphs: Dzvin.co helps people record stress, mood, energy and focus, review trends and find potentially useful wellbeing activities.
There are separate experiences for individuals, organizations and research programs.

sections.title: First steps
paragraphs: Create an account or sign in. Open My Day, complete a short self-check and review the available guidance.
Check in consistently. Trends matter more than a single daily score.

sections.title: Interpreting results
paragraphs: A single response reflects one moment, not your overall health.
Some functionality is limited by role or release stage.

articles.title: Personal Workstream
articles.summary: Daily check-ins, questionnaires and progress

sections.title: Daily checks
paragraphs: The standard check-in covers stress, mood, energy and focus on a 1–5 scale.
Notes and repeated observations offer context, but cannot establish causation.

sections.title: Suggestions and exercises
paragraphs: Relevant exercises and suggestions may follow a check-in. Personal features also support viewing history and goals.
Compare periods rather than trying to optimize one number.

sections.title: Questionnaires
paragraphs: Short psychological questionnaires may help with self-reflection.
They do not establish a diagnosis or prescribe treatment.

articles.title: Organizational Workstream
articles.summary: Aggregated patterns and decision support

sections.title: Organizational use
paragraphs: The team experience helps analyze group-level changes in stress, energy and wellbeing.
Available reports and access depend on user permissions and organization settings.

sections.title: Acting on signals
paragraphs: A risk signal should prompt further contextual review, not an automated judgement about an employee.
Do not make personnel decisions from one aggregate metric. Small groups may still permit re-identification.

sections.title: Responsibilities
paragraphs: Organizations remain responsible for appropriate legal grounds for processing and transparent staff communication.
Aggregation alone does not ensure anonymity.

articles.title: Research Workstream
articles.summary: Cohorts, repeated observations and evidence quality

sections.title: Research workflows
paragraphs: Research scenarios include cohort comparisons, repeated measurements and program outcome reviews.
Access to a feature does not imply independent clinical validation of every model.

sections.title: Evidence quality
paragraphs: Specify samples, metrics, windows, missing-data handling and quality criteria before analysis.
Separate correlation, prediction and causal effects. Report uncertainty.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: Research partnerships, data scope and publishing terms are agreed separately.
Ethics and privacy requirements remain applicable.

articles.title: Data Governance and Privacy
articles.summary: Data processing, access and user rights

sections.title: Your data
paragraphs: The service may process account information, voluntary assessments and product interactions.
The current Privacy Policy defines the precise categories, purposes and legal basis.

sections.title: Workplace access
paragraphs: Organizational reports must respect permissions and applicable privacy rules.
Avoid entering unnecessary sensitive details and never share account credentials.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: Use official Dzvin.co contacts to request access, correction or deletion of personal data.
This guide does not replace the Privacy Policy or Terms of Service.

articles.title: Scope, Limitations and Safety
articles.summary: What indicators and predictions can and cannot establish

sections.title: Uncertainty
paragraphs: Self-reports may be incomplete, biased or context-dependent. Forecasts and risk indicators do not guarantee outcomes.
Recommendations are not proof of causal effects.

sections.title: Medical boundary
paragraphs: Dzvin.co is not an emergency service. It does not diagnose conditions or replace medical or psychological care.
For an immediate safety or health emergency, contact local emergency services.

sections.title: Availability
paragraphs: Some reports and modules may be role-restricted or not generally available while the product evolves.
For current availability, consult the FAQ or support team.
